props.name: title
props.description: The headline — what went wrong, in plain language.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional secondary line — detail or next step.

props.name: status
props.description: Feedback status driving the default icon's color and glyph.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level for the title, so it fits the surrounding document outline.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Recovery button label (e.g. "Try again"). Omit to render no button.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when the recovery button is pressed.

props.name: actions
props.type: { label: string; onAction?: () => void; variant?: ButtonVariant; href?: string; target?: string; }[] | Snippet
props.description: Configurable action group. An entry with `href` renders a `Link` (a direct pathway, e.g. "Learn more" documentation); the others render `Button`s: the first gets the `default` variant and the rest `ghost`, unless an entry sets its own `variant`. Takes precedence over `actionLabel`. A snippet in its place replaces the whole area.

props.name: size
props.description: Density: `md` for full pages and sections, `sm` inside cards, panels and table areas.

props.name: icon
props.description: Glyph or illustration in place of the default `FeedbackIcon`.
